text:
Marisa C: Heads up - handing off Wave 5 beta to CS tomorrow AM. Want a quick activation script checklist and the post-onboard feedback touchpoints in one place. I'll paste drafts below.

Anika R: Thanks - two quick asks: is the sandbox API key scoped to the preview model family? we accidentally gave full model access last time.

Devon K: It should be scoped. I'll validate. Also adding a canary step so we don't blast all seats at once. snippet:
```bash
# canary enable (10%)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/beta/activate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"customer_id":"{{cust}}","percent":10,"model_variant":"rwd-preview-v1"}'
```

Sam Patel: For Acme specifically we need SSO invites created before activation - they can't access the console until SSO is set up. Can Ops queue the SAML onboarding?

Marisa C: Good catch. I've scheduled a 2pm Tues SSO window with infra. @Devon K can you add a gating check so activation waits for `sso_status == "enabled"`?

Devon K: Yep. Will add this to `activation.yaml` and the runtime guard. Quick config snippet:
```yaml
prechecks:
  - name: sso_enabled
    condition: ctx.sso_status == 'enabled'
    fail_message: 'SSO not enabled for customer'
```

onboard-bot: Reminder: run `preflight wave5` before sending invites. See https://console.redwood.example/onboard/preflight

Anika R: Also let's include a 2-question survey in the post-onboard email (subject: "How's Wave 5 going?") - short NPS + one open field for "most confusing part". Use tiny link: https://tiny.redwood/wave5-survey

Marisa C: Draft post-onboard email (short):
"Subject: Welcome to Wave 5 - quick setup & one ask"
"Hi {{name}},
Welcome - your preview is live. Quick checklist: 1) SSO access 2) API key in Console > API keys 3) try the sample prompt in Quickstart. After 3 sessions please give us 60s feedback: https://tiny.redwood/wave5-survey
Thanks - Marisa"

Devon K: I'll hook telemetry: console routes for this cohort -> `/metrics/beta/wave5` and add event `beta_onboarded` with properties {customer_id, seats_enabled, sso, initial_calls}. We'll wire an alert if calls < 5 in 7 days (possible renewal risk).

Sam Patel: Can we tag low-activity customers with `renewal:at-risk` automatically so AMs get a task?

Marisa C: Yes - rule: after 7 days if `calls < 5` AND `tickets_open > 0` then add tag and create AM task. I'll own the playbook doc.

Devon K: One more ops note - need Envoy cert rotation for `acme-inc` cluster. Ping me the cluster id and I'll rotate before activation window.

Sam Patel: Cluster id `acme-prod-42`, thanks.

Marisa C: Awesome - no other blockers from my side. I'll send the final invites at 09:00 tomorrow and post a short status update in #customer-success. :thumbsup:
